biotools.summary: BasalCell is a project scaffolding system designed to lower technical barriers in bioinformatics by providing a standardized, reproducible template for integrating multi-language development environments (R and Python). It enables researchers to manage rigorous development workflows and enhance transparency in biological data science.
biotools.name: BasalCell: Project Scaffold Generator
